title: PageResponse
description: Response body returned by the page render endpoint. Produced by the 4-stage pipeline (getInfoData → getState → render → flatten) and consumed by the Flutter SDK.

pageId.description: Stable page identifier. Matches Page.id in the engine.

title.description: Page title (used by the SDK for route/app-bar titles).

state.description: Initial state declarations from Page.getState(). The SDK seeds its ElmStore with these before rendering.

components.description: Flat node array produced by the encoder. Root is first; children reference other nodes by id.
